name: Ramm to the Slaughter
source:
A visual novel about a tired barista, who longs to escape his stalker. Things take a turn when his wish is granted in the worst way possible.

[From [url=https://patchoulibard.itch.io/ramm-to-the-slaughter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個疲憊的咖啡師盼著擺脫跟蹤自己的人。願望竟以最糟糕的方式實現時，事態也隨之急轉直下。

［摘自[url=https://patchoulibard.itch.io/ramm-to-the-slaughter]itch.io[/url]］
